headline: Costco expansion momentum: new California location opening, international supplier partnerships (K-beauty), and strong investor confidence signal growth opportunity

signals.summary: Costco's new California location nearing completion with opening date revealed, demonstrating continued physical retail expansion and operational momentum.
signals.suggestedAction: Confirm capacity planning and logistics requirements for the new location; identify opportunities to support expanded operations across supply chain, facilities, or technology solutions.

signals.summary: K-beauty supplier APR launching in U.S. Costco warehouses in September 2026, indicating Costco's expansion into new product categories and international vendor partnerships.
signals.suggestedAction: Monitor Costco's vendor diversification strategy and product category expansion; assess opportunity to support new supplier onboarding, logistics, or international sourcing initiatives.
